checklist_items.title: Django MTV Architecture và Setup

checklist_items.market_relevance: Secure authentication là bắt buộc cho APIs

checklist_items.description: ModelAdmin, list_display, list_filter, search_fields, inlines, custom actions, admin themes (Jazzmin)

checklist_items.description: django-filter, FilterSet, SearchFilter, OrderingFilter, PageNumberPagination, CursorPagination

checklist_items.description: Dockerfile, gunicorn, collectstatic, whitenoise, K8s init container migrations, health check endpoint, secrets
